narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran kinetic exchange escalates beyond a one-off strike, with Iran retaliating and shooting down a US Apache. Simultaneous Israel-Hezbollah and Ukraine-Russia intensifications create a multi-front crisis, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; overweight energy equities (XLE) and long WTI crude oil futures.

narratives.title: Strait of Hormuz Blockade Persists
narratives.summary: The EIA projects the Hormuz blockade lasting through Q3 2026, with Kuwait actively seeking pipeline bypasses. Oil prices are structurally supported by supply disruption, though a potential diplomatic deal could reverse this quickly.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures; long tanker equities (STNG, EURN); short airline stocks (JETS) on elevated fuel costs.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Accelerates
narratives.summary: Despite BTC's macro-driven selloff, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure continue, exemplified by Janus Henderson's partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs. This signals long-term capital rotation into digital assets as a distinct asset class.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate BTC on dips; long ETH and DeFi tokens (ENA); overweight crypto-exposed equities (MSTR, COIN).
